field_principles.accepted_finding_count: Bare scalar prevents prose from inflating zero accepted deltas.
field_principles.accepted_findings: Accepted deltas must be post-marker or newly actionable, non-duplicate, and bounded to allocated Exp5798-Exp5807 controls.
field_principles.actual_search_wall_time_s: Wall time is bibliographic search time only, not model, solver, benchmark, or hardware compute.
field_principles.candidate_findings: Every surfaced candidate is dispositioned before it can influence a Carnot task.
field_principles.closed_scope_review: Documents that banned research scopes remain closed.
field_principles.closed_scopes_reopened: Retired scopes require explicit operator authorization outside this workflow.
field_principles.duplicate_checks: Summarizes source-id, URL, title, and local-ledger duplicate checks.
field_principles.duplicate_findings: Planner-covered or already-ledgered sources remain visible but cannot create duplicate roadmap work.
field_principles.excluded_findings: Closed scopes and unsupported mechanisms remain closed by explicit disposition.
field_principles.experiment: Stable local experiment slug for result indexing.
field_principles.experiment_id: Binds this receipt to the conductor task id.
field_principles.field_principles: Maps every artifact field to its evidence boundary.
field_principles.gates_unchanged: Bibliographic refresh cannot rewrite conductor gate requirements.
field_principles.hardware_claim_changed: Public source metadata cannot change FPGA, TSU, Kona, speed, energy, or execution claims.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal summary starts with complete: or blocked: and does not inflate novelty.
field_principles.inaccessible_findings: Access failures are recorded separately and never promoted.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The run synthesizes primary source metadata and local ledger evidence without experiment LLM inference.
field_principles.milestone: Prevents V517 source receipts from being reused for another milestone.
field_principles.planner_marker: Binds the search window to the V517 planner ledger boundary.
field_principles.planner_marker_found: Shows whether the source window was anchored before mutation.
field_principles.planner_marker_hash: Content-addressed marker context detects silent planner-block drift.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records marker, roadmap-id/gate, exclusion, reference, active-roadmap, optional-next-roadmap, conductor, and network availability checks before findings are trusted.
field_principles.primary_source_receipts: Primary metadata receipts show arXiv and directly named source availability before any hypothesis is promoted.
field_principles.random_seed: Deterministic metadata even though the run performs no stochastic science.
field_principles.references_after_hash: Hash of research-references.md after any optional append.
field_principles.references_before_hash: Hash of research-references.md before any optional append.
field_principles.references_modified: The reference-ledger mutation state is declared and must be false when no accepted non-duplicate delta exists.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Stable content checksum detects artifact drift.
field_principles.result_path: Records where the JSON receipt is written.
field_principles.roadmap_ids_unchanged: Bibliographic refresh cannot rewrite allocated task identity.
field_principles.roadmap_immutability: Hashes roadmap identities and gates before and after the write path.
field_principles.run_date: Records the operator-requested execution date in compact form.
field_principles.schema: Identifies the versioned Exp5797 artifact schema.
field_principles.search_finished_at: Records the real UTC instant after final source disposition.
field_principles.search_started_at: Records the real UTC instant before external querying starts.
field_principles.search_window: States the post-marker inclusion rule and execution timestamp range without relying on mutable search indexes.
field_principles.secondary_source_receipts: Secondary feeds and discovery routes are context only unless backed by primary source metadata or local receipts.
field_principles.semantic_scholar_citation_receipts: Citation-route receipts are direct API evidence and do not become stable citation-count claims.
field_principles.source_queries: Search intent is reconstructable without trusting memory.
field_principles.spec_refs: OpenSpec anchors for this artifact behavior.
field_principles.status: Terminal state is derived from source reachability, marker anchoring, and protected-boundary checks.
field_principles.target_experiment_map: Maps accepted findings only to allocated Exp5798-Exp5807 work.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Observed exit codes are recorded without relabeling failures.
field_principles.watch_only_findings: Relevant but non-executable or non-local material is monitored without supporting Carnot execution claims.
